metadata.title: Groupicorn Idaho IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This September 22, 2026 pass prioritized the listed Idaho gaps, adding official One Love Agency offices in Twin Falls, Pocatello, and Idaho Falls. Shortlists use distinct provider groups and preserve research gaps rather than padding thin markets.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.
